## 1. Prediction market

Prices come from the confirmed reading of August 25, 3:22 PM BRT, and the **total accumulated volume of the presidential book is USD 132.88M**. **Lula closed at 62.50% (USD 8.97M) for a second straight day with no change** and **Flávio Bolsonaro gave back 0.40pp to 34.65% (USD 8.89M)**, returning part of the previous day's 1.80pp rise. The distance between the two widened again, from 27.45pp to **27.85pp**, and it widened without the leader gaining anything.

The day's movement sits outside the main book. In **first-round third place**, **Ronaldo Caiado rose 3.00pp to 42.00% (USD 0.06M)**, the largest gain on the panel in any book, and **Renan Santos gave back 2.50pp to 51.50% (USD 0.20M)**, the largest loss. The gap between the two fell from 15.00pp to **9.50pp** in a single day.

**Flávio Bolsonaro had his two contracts moving in opposite directions.** While giving ground in the presidential book, in **first-round second place he rose 2.00pp to 87.50% (USD 0.37M)**. The market grew more convinced he reaches the runoff and slightly less convinced he wins. These are different questions and the panel does not subtract one from the other.

In the presidential book, the trailing pack stays on the floor: **Renan Santos at 2.95% (USD 11.09M)**, with more volume than the leader himself, **Caiado at 0.55% (USD 6.59M)** after giving back 0.15pp, **Romeu Zema at 0.25% (USD 5.98M)** and **Pablo Marçal at 0.15% (USD 2.66M)**. The last three sit below the 0.5% floor at which the double reading can separate price from noise. The institutional contracts did not move: **Supreme Court at 3.40% (USD 84 thousand)** and **Senate with the PL at 77.50% (USD 0.26M)**. In **inflation**, the 5.00% to 5.49% band pays **50.25% (USD 15 thousand)**, with the bands totalling 102.95%, inside the 95% to 105% gate.

## 2. What the institutes recorded

**There was no new national poll this Tuesday.** The batch released by [Quaest](https://news.google.?oc=5) covers Rio Grande do Norte, Paraná, Rio Grande do Sul, Alagoas, Maranhão and Santa Catarina, and the AFOS panel only cross-references national scope. The country's most recent national poll is still the **BTG/Nexus** of August 24, registration BR-09028/2026, fieldwork August 21 to 23, 2,006 interviews.

What circulated today about that round was reading, not new measurement: [CNN Brasil](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxQTkhZcFZUei1LSU9fWUVJUmFhbDBFX0p2bVpCdjVEZ3RueGpHeEVSS2ZkX2ZpUEpBckFqRk8yTEFFOGlSdHRYQ2NQcUpzcC1tZW1TaTNUeU12UXlxYWphS2dHRHo1NXFrVkREdjZCSHhfUkVveVZ1NGpkUjBSMUFhQVNPUGt6SGpkZFhKNFVydnpOMGZ3OXBKQ0FjVzFESmxzRWpUN1R3?oc=5) reports 43% negative ratings against 35% positive, and [VEJA](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixgFBVV95cUxNNnZjc2RmX3E0Y0x0RWlVWmQ5dG4wdXZDMTVRVXpBcmVvMHVxYWtSUjBreUNuYi1VS0NTeE9Gbmdpbmg0ZFVmTXFCY3hIRDhQMW5FemVzWjFocVFBWEpFVW9KNmVVeFdiYXpyQ3RvRXFJVGt0UmNMaF93Zk9vSnpEaEpUSEhYa1J3Z3gzSUtUZW0yNmZGaXNXRjhPaTFFejhxSjI0NHZ3QUQ2bkMyVXRneklSajBOV1Vxc0xENG52WVczai1kdUE?oc=5) states that Lula overtakes Flávio Bolsonaro in rejection for the first time since April, at 49% against 48%. The claim of a first is the magazine's, and the panel attributes it rather than signing it.

## 3. What the press covered

The day's investigative fact is **Operation Presciência**. The Federal Police served [six search and seizure warrants](https://www.gazetadopovo.com.br/economia/pf-mira-previdencia-campo-grande-aplicacao-1-2-milhao-master/) at public bodies and addresses of those under investigation, examining the placement of **R$ 1.2 million** from the Campo Grande Municipal Pension Institute into Banco Master financial notes. [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mercado/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mercado/2026/08/pf-faz-busca-e-apreensao-em-instituto-de-previdencia-de-campo-grande-por-investimentos-no-master.shtml), [Estadão](https://www.estadao.com.br/politica/blog-do-fausto-macedo/pf-faz-ofensiva-contra-suposta-fraude-em-investimentos-da-previdencia-de-campo-grande-no-master/) and [Valor](https://valor.globo.com/financas/noticia/2026/08/25/operacao-da-pf-apura-aplicacao-de-r-12-milhao-da-previdencia-de-campo-grande-no-banco-master.ghtml) carry the same figure. The inquiry covers suspected reckless management and corruption, with no ruling on the merits.

On the calendar, the top two candidates accepted the format they had refused two days earlier. [Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro confirmed](https://news.google.?oc=5) they will take part in the Jornal Nacional interviews, Lula on August 27 and his rival on [August 28](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxQYXdESzN6bDU5UjhDNElmSXNzSTRBS20weTRLLTFydHAxdVNPNWFnZ2RTTFVJOWJwSXFfSFVFYUpZTURqSndpV094XzlkeEU1aWJ6LWRvUFlneENodmw1ZGdvU3FrSnZUclFXazNrVkJsNHZ3TjN2NlItUklkWFN5b05RWU1weEhrVVVCLUpsUDE2T095RmtzcnA1aVdLcWJGSkNRSUxXWQ?oc=5), live from the network's Rio studios. Both skipped the Band debate on August 23. The series of six interviews opened on August 24 with [Romeu Zema](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE5uR1NhUmNrTGhGUkJTYmZuSVNqU3JnS0pxQTFzb2I0RkpIVnBvT3BxZFZLcWFZTlRZRWpkWGx5S0EyZVVnd1JiTnkyZjRnVkRfODlEZ1cxVUxqYzhvR0tSeE9R0gFnQVVfeXFMTy1iMXNlVnhGQnltRXItdmhHWWZmZHl6cV9OQkVtRTl1T3ZDaUQybF9YWmVaMDBLWkJjQ3YyS2wwZ1hLUWgyMWxUbEotR3VHRmtZbHFJN011T05XRmRpNnY0Q293eVhmOA?oc=5), 40 minutes, and had **Ronaldo Caiado this Tuesday**, the second of the six. Zema was questioned again on August 25, this time by [O Globo, Valor and CBN](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/eleicoes-2026/noticia/2026/08/25/o-globo-valor-e-cbn-iniciam-sabatinas-transmitidas-ao-vivo-com-candidatos-a-presidencia.ghtml).

On the institutional beat, the Dark Horse case reached the runner-up through coverage. Asked about the film's accounts after Justice Flávio Dino's decision, he [replied that the one who has accounts to answer for is his rival](https://news.google.?oc=5), demanding that the money be traced. [Poder360](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxOTFdNcDV0Mk01elpZRHlNTWVFUHV6NUR0VTJ3QjdzLUZpbWdKUjE5S24zMDZfMUNHbDBYQjBrcFBZTmRRNERkUmUxcXNHRjg1bE1mOGRaVjZKSWtmWHg2X0tXeTQzSVZLNWdlT1REdVlKSmZHWTFyS2owQ2MxQ3JhaGxGbWhvUlNNMmFmdExkdDZGb055NzdwdURRWmJwU190dklkdHYyUEo5azRud0w4ZXlXdVVxcWc?oc=5) describes the answer as a dodge. [Estadão](https://news.google.?oc=5) reports that the top two candidates have been avoiding uncontrolled settings so as not to be questioned about Daniel Vorcaro and about the president's son.

## 4. Divergences of the day

> **Market × poll:** the third-place price moved toward the polls today, and it is the first convergence on that point in weeks. The BTG/Nexus of August 24 puts Caiado at 5% and Renan Santos at 3%, while the contract was paying more for the latter. The gap fell from 15.00pp to 9.50pp, and the contract's order did not flip.

> **Series × instant:** the 9.50pp is not the narrowest gap ever recorded in this contract. The same book was at **3.5pp on August 22 at 7:30 PM**, and that day's close read 15.5pp. Anyone comparing daily closes never sees the floor and would conclude a series low where there is none.

> **Price × event:** none of the day's facts moved a price. The police operation, the confirmed interviews and the pressure over Dark Horse coexist with the leader standing still for a second day and with an institutional contract at 3.40%, with no relevant variation.

## In summary

1. The largest move of the day was in a side contract, not the main one: **Caiado rose 3.00pp and Renan Santos gave back 2.50pp** in third place, and the price moved closer to the order the polls show.
2. **There was no new national poll**, and Quaest's state-level batch does not enter the cross-reference by scope. Four national polls are registered for the next seven days, the largest with 6,000 interviews.
3. **Flávio Bolsonaro's** two contracts moved in opposite directions on the same day, which is market reading and not contradiction: reaching the runoff and winning the election are distinct bets.
